trace.question: How many patients with an Ig G higher than normal?
trace.evidence: Ig G higher than normal refers to IGG >= 2000; Should consider DISTINCT in the final result;

attempts.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory
WHERE IGG >= 2000

trace.final_sql:
